title: The Old Debt
text: A notary arrives with your grandfather's signature on a debt to another Great House: a whole wing of your Seat, pledged against a loan never repaid. The other House has not asked for it. The notary says it must be settled before Midwinter, one way or another.

options.label: Pay off your grandfather's debt in gold to clear his name.

outcomes.text: The debt is cleared. Your vault is lighter and your grandfather's name cleaner, and you sleep well.

options.label: Hand a building to the House you name, as your grandfather pledged.

outcomes.text: Your masons hand the keys to theirs. The other House is gracious about it in public, and the city calls you a House that keeps its word.

options.label: Let the debt ride; your grandfather's promises died with him.

outcomes.text: Midwinter comes and goes. The notary posts the debt on the Commons door for the city to read.
